test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 25 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: An annual instalment of ₹3,500 will discharge a debt of ₹16,310 due in 4 years at y% simple interest per annum. What is the value of y? [Note: Instalments will be paid at the end of Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4.
solution:
**Given:**

Annual installment = ₹3,500

Debt = ₹16,310

Time = 4 years

Simple interest rate = y% per annum

**Formula used:**

Total amount paid = Sum of installments including interest

Interest for year 1 = ₹3,500 × y% × 3 years

Interest for year 2 = ₹3,500 × y% × 2 years

Interest for year 3 = ₹3,500
